text: ASCII Whales 是一款 DSH Web 插件，为新对话的聊天背景绘制由字符组成的鲸鱼与鱼群，并为输入框添加可调节的中性毛玻璃效果。它接入 DSH 设置页和对话背景区域，可选择座头鲸或虎鲸、ASCII／汉字／Kanji 风格，调整数量、速度、大小、颜色、网格、尾迹和字体，也能启用减少动态效果适配。鲸群只在新对话背景显示，进入已有对话后自动隐藏。适合希望为 DSH Web 聊天界面增加轻量海洋氛围并细调外观的用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务，偏好保存在当前浏览器。

ASCII Whales adds animated character whales and fish to new DSH Web chats, with a frosted-glass composer. Choose species, glyph style, colors, and motion settings. It hides in active conversations and respects reduced motion. No API key or external service is needed.
我想给 DSH 新对话加一个字符风格的鲸鱼背景。
DSH 聊天输入框能不能变成可调节的毛玻璃效果？
我想把背景里的鲸鱼换成虎鲸，还能改数量和游速。
让聊天背景用汉字而不是普通 ASCII 字符来画鲸鱼。
能不能给聊天页面加一个 Kanji 字符动画主题？
我想换鲸鱼和尾迹的颜色，还要调网格和鱼群密度。
DSH 有没有会跟随深浅主题、支持减少动态效果的背景装饰？
Can I add an ASCII whale ocean to the background of new DSH chats?
How can I customize the whales, glyph style, colors, and frosted composer in DSH?
ASCII Whales 的功能「新对话鲸群背景」：在 DSH 对话内容区域叠加字符海洋画布，仅当对话处于 hero 阶段且功能启用时显示；开始对话后自动隐藏。
ASCII Whales 的功能「动画与外观设置」：在设置页切换座头鲸或虎鲸、字符风格、鲸鱼数量和尺寸，并调节颜色、速度、尾迹、网格、鱼群及透明度；修改后即时更新背景。
ASCII Whales 的功能「字体选择」：可使用随插件提供的字体，或输入本机中英文字体名称；支持的浏览器还可扫描本机字体并从菜单选择。
ASCII Whales 的功能「深浅主题与毛玻璃输入框」：背景根据页面主题更新配色，输入框可单独启用模糊层，并调节模糊半径与透明度；不支持模糊的浏览器使用不透明背景回退。
ASCII Whales 的功能「动画生命周期适配」：当动画离开视口、页面进入后台或用户启用系统减少动态效果时暂停持续动画，并在组件卸载时清理观察器与事件监听。
ASCII Whales 使用浏览器本地存储保存外观偏好；本机字体扫描依赖浏览器提供 queryLocalFonts，若 API 不可用或权限未授予，可手动输入字体名称。

dsh-ascii-whales README · ASCII 鲸鱼 · DeepSeek Harness：让鲸群游过留白，让思绪慢慢浮出水面。

新对话展开时，蓝色鲸群从字符之间游来。细小的鱼群随水流散开，尾迹缓缓隐去；输入框像一片磨砂玻璃，轻轻托住尚未写下的话。

[English](README.en.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ascii-whales) · [Releases](https://github.com/Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales/releases)

dsh-ascii-whales README · 安装：在 DeepSeek Harness 的插件管理中添加 npm 包 **`dsh-ascii-whales`**，完成后重启相应实例。

Web CLI 用户也可使用：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ascii-whales
```

将 `web` 换成目标 Web profile。Desktop 请通过客户端插件管理安装。

插件默认启用，配置入口为 **设置 → ASCII 鲸鱼**。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 一片海，两种光：动画铺在整个空白聊天主区域，位于标题与输入框后方。它保留原项目的 ASCII 字符色块、身体弯曲、鱼群游动与扩散尾迹；鲸鱼以不同大小游过，默认主色为 DeepSeek 蓝 `#4d6bfe`。

浅色像日光下的水面，深色像夜里的海。毛玻璃使用中性白／深灰透明层，没有额外的蓝色 tint；经过后方的鲸鱼会自然透出模糊的颜色。开始已有对话后，装饰自动退场。

选中的颜色落在鲸鱼身体的中间调，暗面压深、亮面提亮，保留逐格光照层次与身体立体感。两种主题沿用同一套鱼身配色，让你的那一抹蓝，在日夜之间都留得住。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 调一调你的海：新增 **字符风格 → Kanji**：改编自 MIT 许可的 [ascii-kanji-sharks](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks)，使用鲸鱼形态，使用 stackedlol/ascii-sharks 的游动与鱼群模拟，保留 Kanji 上游按笔画密度生成的明暗与捕食文字效果。沿用数量、大小、速度、颜色、网格、尾迹和字体设置；字符栅格最低为 4 px（达到下限后不再缩小）。Kanji（日文汉字）使用“中文字体名称”；英文字体设置仅作用于 ASCII。字体离线内置，原有 ASCII／汉字鲸鱼仍可选。

使用 DSH 官方的设置页、按钮、输入框与开关。颜色区提供可视化色块及系统选色器，选色后即时生效。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 调一调你的海：也可以让汉字入海：**设置 → ASCII 鲸鱼 → 字符风格 → 汉字**。吻部落“吻”，眼睛落“目”，背部落“背”，胸鳍与背鳍落“鳍”，尾鳍落“尾”；其余鲸身由水、海、潮、鲸等字铺开，小鱼化作鱼字旁的游字。字随身体弯曲转向。三种样式按近似相同的字符格面积校准颗粒感：ASCII 保留窄格，汉字与 Kanji 使用方格，采用固定 CSS 像素尺寸，不随窗口宽度变化。1× 时 ASCII 为 8×12 px，汉字与 Kanji 为 10×10 px；仍可用“字符栅格”调节。

英文默认内置 **Geist Mono 600**，与原项目演示一致；汉字默认内置 **思源宋体**。两套字体用于动画，随插件离线加载。切换“字体 → 本机自定义”，可分别填写已安装的中英文字体名称，例如 `Consolas`、`方正屏显雅宋简体`。

点击 **扫描本机字体**，允许浏览器访问字体后，即可从下拉菜单中选择，也可直接输入字体名称。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 调一调你的海：| 设置 | 默认 | 范围 / 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 显示海洋 | 开 | 控制整个背景与配套玻璃 |
| 鲸鱼种类 | 座头鲸 | 座头鲸 / 虎鲸；三种字符风格均可切换并保存 |
| 字符风格 | ASCII | ASCII / 汉字 / Kanji；即时切换并保存 |
| 字体 | 内置默认 | 内置默认 / 本机自定义；中英文字体名称分别保存 |
| 眼睛底色 | 跟随主色 | 控制眼睛位置的背景方块；默认沿用身体底色，可选黑色／白色，字符自动使用对比色。Kanji 默认透明，选黑／白后增加眼睛底色块 |
| 彩色闪烁 | 关 | ASCII / 汉字：关闭使用主色深浅，开启恢复原版七色字符点缀；不改变身体主色。Kanji 使用自身闪光效果，此开关不适用 |
| 海洋颜色 | DeepSeek 蓝 | 可视化选色器；同步鱼群、尾迹配色 |
| 鲸鱼数量 | 3 | 1–20 |
| 鲸鱼大小 | 1.2 倍 | 0.1–10 倍，保留个体大小差异 |
| 游动速度 | 0.65 倍 | 0.1–10 倍 |
| 身体摆动幅度 | 0.8 倍 | 0–3 倍；0 关闭身体波动，仍会沿转弯路径弯身 |
| 转弯灵活度 | 0.7 倍 | 0.1–3 倍；越高越容易弯身掉头 |
| 摆尾频率 | 0.8 倍 | 0.1–5 倍；独立于游动速度 |
| 动画透明度 | 1 | 0–1；1 为完全不透明 |
| 字符栅格 | 1 倍 | 0.1–10 倍；越大越有颗粒感 |
| 底纹网格透明度 | 0.05 | 0–1；0 隐藏底纹 |
| 小鱼数量 | 170 | 0–1000；0 隐藏小鱼 |
| 尾迹强度 | 1 | 0–10；0 隐藏扩散尾迹 |
| 毛玻璃输入框 | 开 | 独立开关 |
| 玻璃模糊 | 14 px | 0–64 px |
| 玻璃不透明度 | 0.45 | 0–1；越高越不透 |

dsh-ascii-whales README · 调一调你的海：大小、栅格、速度、尾迹在 1 以下以 **0.05** 为步长，从 1 起以 **0.1** 为步长；跨界为 `0.95 ↔ 1 ↔ 1.1`，也可直接输入数值。

座头鲸保留长胸鳍和宽尾叶；虎鲸采用更宽的圆钝头部、短圆胸鳍，以及独立于眼睛底色的白色眼斑与侧腹斑。两种鲸鱼都保留自选主色，虎鲸白斑固定为浅白色。

三种样式均接入鲸鱼种类、显示开关、数量、大小、速度、透明度、字符栅格、网格透明度、小鱼数量、尾迹强度、颜色、字体及毛玻璃的开关／模糊／不透明度。颜色作用于身体、小鱼和尾迹；眼睛背景方块默认沿用身体底色，可单独选择黑色或白色；Kanji 的闪光与拟声文字保留主题强调色。

默认三条鲸鱼的相对大小为 100%、70%、84%。ASCII 小鱼以短横字符呈现，汉字模式使用鱼、鲤、鲭、鲱，尺寸随字符栅格一起变化。

**恢复默认** 使用 DSH 官方主按钮，随深浅主题切换，可一键回到最初的蓝色海面。偏好保存在当前浏览器。动画遵循系统“减少动态效果”设置，并在后台标签页暂停。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 从哪里游来：基于 [stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks) 的源码改造。原作者完成了鱼群模拟、柔性身体、字符栅格与光影渲染；本项目在其基础上加入鲸鱼形态、DSH 集成、主题适配与可调参数。

**Kanji**样式改编自 [michikusa404](https://github.com/michikusa404) 创作的 **[ascii-kanji-sharks · 漢字の海](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks)**（MIT License，Copyright © 2026 michikusa404）。汉字笔画密度明暗与文字特效源于该项目；本项目将形态改为鲸鱼，并负责 DSH 接入、透明背景、可调参数与离线字体适配。完整许可保留在 [vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE](vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE)。

dsh-ascii-whales README · 从哪里游来：感谢 **michikusa404** 将汉字化作海洋，也感谢 **stackedlol** 创作的字符鱼群与动画实现。感谢两位原作者公开源码，让这片海能够游进 DeepSeek Harness。

固定的上游版本、改动范围与署名见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。毛玻璃实现参考了 [dsh-glass-theme](https://github.com/cnayu/dsh-glass-theme) 与 [dsh-skin-glass](https://github.com/noexcs/dsh-skin-glass) 的相关思路。

动画与字体随插件一起打包，可离线加载。

测试与 GIF 录制见 [开发文档](docs/development.md)，测试结果见 [验证记录](docs/validation.md)。

Kanji 的游动、追逐、转向和身体摆动与 ASCII／汉字共用 stackedlol/ascii-sharks 运动模拟；保留鲸鱼轮廓，采用 Kanji 字符明暗和文字特效。

dsh-ascii-whales README · ASCII Whales · DeepSeek Harness：Let whales drift through the quiet, and thoughts rise to the surface.

A blue ocean unfolds behind each empty chat. Schools of tiny fish scatter between characters; wakes fade slowly, and a pane of frosted glass holds the words you have yet to write.

[中文](README.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ascii-whales) · [Releases](https://github.com/Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales/releases)

dsh-ascii-whales README · Install：Add **`dsh-ascii-whales`** through DeepSeek Harness's plugin manager, then restart that instance. For a Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ascii-whales
```

Open **Settings → ASCII Whales**. Use Desktop's own plugin manager for Desktop installations.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Your ocean：The animation fills the empty chat area behind the title and composer. It follows the native light/dark theme and disappears in existing conversations. Glass is neutral white or charcoal, with no blue tint; colors passing behind it are naturally blurred.

Your chosen color anchors the whale body's midtones, with deeper shadows and brighter highlights that preserve per-cell lighting and body volume. Both themes use the same body palette, carrying your shade of blue from daylight into night.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Your ocean：Choose **Settings → ASCII Whales → Character style → Hanzi** for Chinese characters: 吻 at the snout, 目 at the eyes, 背 along the back, 鳍 on fins and 尾 on tail flukes. Water and ocean characters fill the body; fish become 鱼, 鲤, 鲭 and 鲱. These labels follow the bending body. Hanzi use wider cells, adjustable with cell size.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Your ocean：The plugin embeds **Geist Mono 600** for ASCII, matching the upstream demo, and **Source Han Serif** for Hanzi. These animation fonts load offline. Choose **Font → Local custom** to enter separate installed English and Chinese font names.

Click **Scan local fonts**, allow browser access, then choose from the dropdown menus. You can also type a font name directly.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Your ocean：Humpbacks retain long flippers and broad flukes. Orcas have a broader rounded head, short rounded flippers, and white eye and flank patches. Both retain your selected body color; the orca patches stay off-white and are independent of the eye-background setting.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Your ocean：| Setting | Default | Range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Show whales | On | Entire scene and its glass |
| Whale species | Humpback | Humpback / Orca; saved and available in all three character styles |
| Character style | ASCII | ASCII / Hanzi / Kanji; applied immediately and saved |
| Font | Bundled default | Bundled default / Local custom; separate saved English and Chinese names |
| Eye background | Follow main color | Controls the eye cell background, with contrasting text. Defaults to body shading; choose black or white. Kanji defaults to transparent and adds an eye tile only for black/white |
| Colorful shimmer | Off | ASCII / Hanzi: selected-color shades by default; enable the original seven-color glyph accents. Body color is unchanged. Not applicable to Kanji |
| Whale color | `#4d6bfe` | Visual swatches and system color picker; fish and wakes follow |
| Whales | 3 | 1–20 |
| Size | 1.2× | 0.1–10× |
| Speed | 0.65× | 0.1–10× |
| Body swing amplitude | 0.8× | 0–3×; zero removes body waves, while the spine still follows turns |
| Turning agility | 0.7× | 0.1–3×; higher values allow tighter turns |
| Tail-beat frequency | 0.8× | 0.1–5×; indepen

dsh-ascii-whales README · Your ocean：Size, cell size, speed and wake step by **0.05** below 1 and **0.1** from 1 upward: `0.95 ↔ 1 ↔ 1.1`. You can also type values directly.

Set grid opacity, fish count or wake to zero to hide it. The default whales have relative sizes of 100%, 70% and 84%; the size control scales them together. Small fish are dashes in ASCII mode and fish characters in Hanzi mode; their dimensions follow the character grid.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Your ocean：Settings use official DSH controls. **Restore defaults** uses the theme-aware primary button and brings back the original blue ocean. Preferences are saved in this browser. The animation follows reduced-motion preferences and pauses in background tabs.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Source and development：This adapts **[stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks)**, retaining its simulation, flexible spines, ASCII rasterizer and lighting. The whale shape, DSH integration, palettes and controls are adaptations. See [source attribution](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for the pinned commit and credits.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Source and development：The **Kanji** style adapts **[ascii-kanji-sharks · 漢字の海](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks)** by **[michikusa404](https://github.com/michikusa404)** (MIT License, Copyright © 2026 michikusa404). Its ink-measured Kanji shading and text effects come from that project; movement and schooling use stackedlol/ascii-sharks. Our adaptations replace the shark silhouette with whales and add DSH integration, a transparent background, adjustable settings and offline fonts. The full license is preserved in [vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE](vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE).

dsh-ascii-whales README · Source and development：Thank you to **michikusa404** for turning Kanji into an ocean, and to **stackedlol** for the character-based schools and animation. Their publicly shared source made it possible to bring this sea into DeepSeek Harness.

```sh
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
npm run check
npm pack
```

Animation and fonts are bundled for offline loading. See [development and recording](docs/development.md) and [test results](docs/validation.md).

dsh-ascii-whales README · Kanji：Choose **Character style → Kanji** for the MIT-licensed [ascii-kanji-sharks](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks) simulation, adapted to whales: schools, ink-measured shading and feeding text effects. Existing population, size, speed, color, grid, wake and font controls apply. Cells have a 4 px minimum (lower settings stop shrinking at this limit). Kanji uses the Chinese font field; the English font field applies only to ASCII. Fonts are bundled for offline use; both whale styles remain available.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Kanji：All three styles support visibility, count, size, speed, opacity, cell size, grid opacity, small fish count, wake intensity, color, fonts and the glass toggle/blur/opacity. Color affects bodies, fish and wakes; eye backgrounds follow body shading by default, with optional black or white. Kanji glints and sound effects retain theme accents. The first three whales use relative sizes of 100%, 70% and 84%.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Kanji：Kanji shares the stackedlol/ascii-sharks simulation, pursuit, turning and body wave with ASCII / Hanzi, retaining the whale silhouette with Kanji shading and text effects.

dsh-ascii-whales README · Kanji：Character cells use comparable areas across styles: ASCII retains narrow cells, while Hanzi and Kanji share square cells. Cell sizes are fixed in CSS pixels, independent of window width: at 1×, ASCII uses 8×12 px and Hanzi/Kanji use 10×10 px. The same multiplier gives similar grain density; full-width cells retain a 4 px minimum.
